Actor Bradley Cooper sits with Joe Rogan for episode 2435 of the Joe Rogan Experience. Cooper rose from comedy roles to directing and starring in films like A Star Is Born and Maestro. Hollywood's serious man shows a relaxed side in the long podcast format.

Cooper talks about fame, craft, and the deep preparation behind his Leonard Bernstein film. He shares what years of rejection taught him about the work. Rogan asks about directing himself and carrying a film on his back. Film fans and the star-struck get a thoughtful star talking like a craftsman, not a celebrity.
